note: SORTER LEVELS (Stephen, 24 Sep 2026): "there should be like an account leveling that just happens naturally like you're a level 3 sorter ... if they don't buy the hero socks then they get more duplicates in loads ... so we need to do it for them ... Some of them it'll unlock all the socks. Some of them it'll be you now will start finding socks from this pack." A level is Loads played, on the difficulty ladder's own counts (TIER_AT). A reward `pack: access` puts the next unowned pack into her Loads (one hero pair in ten, first call on the next ten Loads, like a bought one); `pack: whole` gives the next unowned pack with all ten socks in the Drawer at once. With the three Load size pegs (a pack each) that is seven of the nine paid packs free by 50 Loads; the last two stay in the shop for Quarters, unless she buys ahead (a gift always takes the next pack she does not own). Each level gives once (save.levelGifts).
